Accenture Federal Services is a technology company serving the U.S. federal government and its defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health missions. The Product & Platform Engineering Analyst builds full-stack and cloud-native applications, integrates AI/ML capabilities, and contributes to secure software delivery in collaborative agile teams.

Responsibilities
Build full‑stack applications using languages like Python, Java, and JavaScript
Use modern frameworks such as React, Node.js, and Spring Boot
Develop and deploy cloud-native solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Integrate AI/ML models into production systems responsibly and efficiently
Experiment with emerging technologies, including generative AI and autonomous agents
Contribute to secure, resilient software following DevSecOps and SDLC best practices
Collaborate in agile teams to deliver solutions supporting federal missions
Qualification
Programming
Debugging
Agile Methodologies
Required
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology (with programming focus), or STEM with strong software development coursework, with graduation by August 31, 2027
Strong academic track record (3.2+ cumulative GPA) from a 4-year accredited institution
Strong foundation in programming and software engineering principles
U.S. citizenship required (due to federal contract requirements)
Preferred
Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but requirements vary by team and location
Curiosity to learn about and experiment with agentic, cloud, and automation technologies
Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and debugging skills
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, collaborative, agile teams
Clear communication skills for technical and non‑technical audiences
Demonstrated interest in federal service, mission-driven work, or public impact
Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and concepts
Benefits
Hands-on experience, certifications, and industry training
Mentorship, certifications, and access to the latest technologies through the Analyst Development Program (ADP)
